summary: Resource manager returning the wrong status for a rejected request; the rejection is only visible in slog2
issue: We run the sensor resource manager on the QNX target with `./sensord &`. After `./sensorctl set-rate 75`, sensorctl prints `rate: 75 Hz`, but `./sensorctl get-rate` afterwards still prints `rate: 10 Hz` and the sensor keeps sampling at 10 Hz. 75 Hz is not a supported rate, so per the README sensorctl should have fallen back to 50 Hz and printed `rate: 50 Hz (requested 75)`. Setting a supported rate (1, 10, 50, 100) works. We built both programs with `make` in task/sensord and ran them from /tmp on the target.
